executionKind: local YAML contract validation; no Kubernetes cluster, API server, CNI, image pull, Pod, receiver, or external tool call

staticChecks.message: ServiceAccount token automount must be disabled
RBAC must grant only named ConfigMap get
RoleBinding must bind agent-api to narrow Role
ResourceQuota must bound pod and CPU request budget
base must contain default-deny plus ingress allow NetworkPolicy
default-deny must select ingress and egress
ingress policy must target agent-api labels
Service must select agent-api and named HTTP port
Deployment selector must match Pod template labels
Deployment must use two replicas and zero-unavailable rolling update
Pod must use tokenless agent-api ServiceAccount
Deployment must declare grace period and preStop hook
Deployment must declare named-port readiness and liveness probes
container must declare resource requests and limits
container must use restricted security context
PDB must preserve one selected agent-api Pod
intentional-defect overlay must be rejected: selector does not match template label

intentionalDefect.expected: Deployment selector/template label mismatch is rejected
